name: The Listening Comb
prompt: Set a huge tortoiseshell comb upright, each widely spaced tooth strung with a different taut wire. Operators lean long stethoscopes against the vibrating teeth. Undelivered messages gather as bright ribbons tied near the roots.

name: An Alphabet of Kites
prompt: Suspend a diagonal ladder of black, white and orange paper kites between two low switching rooms. Their angle transmits messages. One operator changes a bridle while another looks along the entire formation through a small brass scope.

name: The Porcelain Switchboard
prompt: Cover a stepped courtyard with blue-and-white porcelain bowls joined by vivid red cords. Operators turn each bowl mouth-down to close a circuit. A line of upturned white interiors traces one unfinished message across the site.

name: Letters on the Laundry Line
prompt: String sheets of pale perforated felt across a fan of parallel washing lines. Telegraph clerks read the moving holes with spring-loaded fingers mounted on carts. A basket of rolled dispatches waits beneath the shortest line.

name: The Semaphore Shadow
prompt: Stand a single cream wall beside an array of jointed vermilion arms on low pivots. A moving lamp projects their signals as giant overlapping shadows. Clerks trace a fleeting silhouette onto strips of paper on the wall.
